description: Congressman Juan Ciscomani's campaign released a new 30-second ad today, "Make Ends Meet," spotlighting the everyday financial pressure Arizona families face just to get by, and the stark contrast between Ciscomani's fight to cut taxes and JoAnna Mendoza's record of pushing for more.
title: NEW AD: As Arizona Families Struggle to Make Ends Meet, Mendoza Fights for More Taxes — Juan Ciscomani for Congress
